notes.title: Full Ace v3.2 update now live! And 35% off!
notes.notes:
Full Ace v3.2 is now live! Now out of beta, v3.2 completes a series of recent updates bringing loads of new features and improvements. And to celebrate, Full Ace is 35% off. We've also updated the Full Ace trailer to showcase the new sizzling goodness. 

[previewyoutube=dSqsOhHG8eQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a rundown of recent v3 updates:
[list]
[*] Interface : Complete makeover for all menus with easier navigation both with mouse/keyboard and controller.
[*] Visuals : Many improvements to character movement animations and the system handling them.
[*] Gameplay/visuals : cosmetic improvements and fixes regarding split steps.
[*] Gameplay : Increased character inertia overall and specifically a substantial increase when hitting a ground stroke on the move. This is a first step so as not to change the game too much at once. More tuning will probably be necessary.
[*] Gameplay : It is now much more easier to run towards the net after hitting the ball.
[*] AI : Improvements to repositioning and inside-out forehands.
[*] Editor : Integrated editor inside the game's general interface.
[*] Career/Tournament : Added possibility to watch matches where the player's selected character is controlled by AI. A specific button was added in the tournament view menu to still be able to have the game quickly simulated by AI.
[*] Quality of life : When resuming a match from a saved game, you are first taken to the pre-game menu where you can choose controller/AI.
[*] Gameplay : Changed shot outcome display style and added the possibility to customise how long it is shown on-screen.
[*] Online : Fixed display for opponent nickname in EXHIBITION menu and Ping display during match. Small change in lobby display to better differentiate players who are currently available for a game from those who aren't.
[*] Cosmetics : Improved serve bar positioning relative to character.
[*] Gameplay : Increased lob height.
[*] QoL : Using the quick-save replay button during a replay or a cutscene triggered skipping said replay or cutscene as well.
[/list]
Thank you for being a part of the Full Ace community and we hope you enjoy these additions and improvements!

notes.title: Full Ace version 3 (interface redesign) is available as a public beta
notes.notes:
We hope you enjoy this redesign, and can help us find some bugs we may have missed.

To play the beta, you need to opt in to it in Steam ([url=https://www.technipages.com/how-to-opt-into-a-game-beta-on-steam/]instructions here[/url]), choosing [u][b]public-beta[/b][/u] (the other ones are password-protected anyway).

[b]You can switch back and forth between beta and regular versions there.[/b] There should be no compatibility issues, and there are no changes related to the gameplay in any way. However the online lobbies for regular and beta are separated.

[u][b]WARNING ![/b][/u]
When using a beta version, you should make back-up copies of your local files in case.

notes.title: Version 2.2.0 : Optimisations and new features
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] General : Optimisations (a lot for player selection and asset loading, some for in-game engine). As a result, the game doesn't need to store textures in the Cache folder any more. Therefore, all files you may already have in that folder become useless and may be deleted.
[*] Modding : Optimisations above include some changes in the way modding behaves, especially with bags and rackets. Some of them won't appear until mod fixes are available.
[*] Interface / Character selection : Character selection has been modified to include a summary of each character's stats.
[*] Gameplay : Smash gameplay has been revised to a similar system as pre-2.0. A gameplay mechanic has been added specifically to ignore smash spot when needed.
[*] Tutorial : Lesson 404 has been added to explain how to ignore smash spot.
[*] Gameplay/Settings : Added possibility to always play facing the camera.
[*] Settings : V-Sync setting is now properly applied in menus, also can be modified from in-game and is applied immediately when modified.
[*] Editor : Added buttons below 3D view, respectively for texture refresh and writing base modding custom textures for outift, racket and bag based on current settings.
[*] Lobby/Visual : Condensed all anonymous users in one line.
[*] Translation : Spanish translation updated courtesy of @jc_hornachos#1804.

[*] Bug fix : Fixed weird behavior when mixing analog and non-analog controls for movement/aiming.
[*] Bug fix : Tried to prevent some rare cases of online crashes that were reported.

notes.title: Version 1.15.13

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.15.12
notes.notes:

[*] Interface : Interface rendering is not limited to 50 fps any more, and the VSync setting is applied.

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.15.8
notes.notes:
* Sounds : Added different ambience sound during play.
* Modding : Umpire sounds calling player names can now be modded according to stadium.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash in animation modding menu when flagging serve animations.

notes.title: Version 1.15.7
notes.notes: * Online : Fixed issue introduced in v1.15.6

notes.title: Version 1.15.6
notes.notes:
* Online : Added messages in ongoing scores list to indicate that a match is being set up/close to beginning.
* Cosmetics : Improved rendering for foot shadow spots.
* Bug fix : Fixed problems when playing with multiple accounts on the same computer.

notes.title: Version 1.15.5 - Quality of life update for editor and online play.
notes.notes:
* Editor/Career : When beginning a career, rankings are now automatically matching the order of players in the editor.
* Editor : It is now possible to reorder editor lists by editing an entry's index instead of drag & dropping.
* Editor : Many QoL improvements and fixes.
* Online : It is now possible to block/unblock users while they are playing.
* Online : Added checkmarks system to authenticate user accounts that have been impersonated.
* Gameplay : Automatic system for serve animations has been improved to avoid any type of foot faults.

notes.title: Version 1.15.4
notes.notes:
* Gameplay (with modded animations) : Added system to constrain hit points for serves and ground strokes. The game will enforce proper hitting zones to ensure gameplay consistency at the detriment of visual racket-ball contact accuracy. It is up to modders to gradually fix all animations accordingly.
* Animation modding : Added tools to visualise hit points and hitting zones to help fixing.
* Animation modding : Added option in modding menu to export only animations from current character.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash when opening SETTINGS menu in certain resolutions.

notes.title: Version 1.15.3 : fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
* Gameplay : Fixed a bug that was a cause of air balls when trying to hit volleys.
* Rules : Fixes (including crash fix) and improvements when displaying scores of matches with direct tie breaks.
* Sound : Removed maximum volume values for bounce and ball-hitting-net effects.
* Animation modding : Small change so that feet flagging is now mandatory on ground stroke animations.
* Cosmetics : Some cosmetic fixes that should improve character motions.
* Rendering : Tuned ambient lighting for indoor courts.
* Bug fix : Small fix for court color in challenge animation when using courts without double alleys.
* Bug fix : Fixed Bind button not working in CONTROLS when in-game.

notes.title: Version 1.15.2
notes.notes:
* Bug fix : Fixed game sometimes getting stuck after hand shake in online games until opponent disconnecting.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash in SETTINGS menu when using controller configuration and plugging/unplugging controllers at the same time.

notes.title: Version 1.15.1
notes.notes:
* Online : Added lag switch protection. This version detects anomalous lag spikes when receiving shot information from opponent. If a lag spike happens and the opponent's ball is in, the point is replayed. If it is out, it is handled normally.
* Ergonomics : Allowed skipping match celebration and hand shake by pushing a button.
* Animations : Improved forehand preparation position.
* Visuals : Improved rendering when racket and character hair are superimposed on screen.
* Visuals : Fixed mirrored logo on character's left wristband and sock.
* Interface : Better handling of UNICODE and special font symbols.
* Bug fix : Fixed player's legs continuing to move when reaching the limits of serve positioning.
* Bug fix : Fixed issue in online games when resuming play at the end of a set using the PAUSE button of any control scheme would pause the game again.
* Bug fix : Fixed other issues with leaving pause.
* Bug fix : Fixed rare cases of online score desync with high lag.
* Bug fix : Fixed rare crash while setting up an online game.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash when handling a corrupted game file.

notes.title: Version 1.15.0 - Online "Quality of life" update
notes.notes:
* Added possibility for friendly (no ELO) matches.
* Added possibility to block other users. Blocked users appear on a red background and are based on their (numerical) Steam ID, not screen name. Invites and chat messages between blocker and blockee are stopped.
* Enabled QUIT button after pushing RESUME GAME button, while waiting for user to rejoin game as well.
* Fixes for some reported crashes.

notes.title: Version 1.14.27
notes.notes:
* Cosmetics : Added time shift & scale in cinematics when both characters are playing the same animation.
* Bug fix : Fixed regression where game would get stuck after serve hitting the net then receiver directly hitting the ball before bounce.

notes.title: Version 1.14.26
notes.notes:
* Gameplay : Fixed buggish behavior where hitting the second tap could improve timing over first tap release, at the same time not visually impacting the orb display.
* Gameplay : Added new timing hint mode that displays only timing feedback.
* Interface : Added "NEXT GAME" menu before launching a game in CAREER or TOURNAMENT modes, allowing to pick controller method, review opponent stats and pick opponent outfit.
* Interface : Character stats can now be shown in CHALLENGE menu.
* Match rules : Matches can now be played where sets are replaced by tie-breaks by setting "Direct tie-break" as Set length.
* Challenge mode : Game can now be restarted at any point (asking for confirmation if current game isn't finished).
* Editor : Added stadium option to choose between natural/outdoor (sun) lighting and artificial/indoor lighting.
* Editor : Improvements to CSV export/import. More stadium parameters are handled, while parameters with textual values use English versions for better portability between users.
* Online : Match score and online score "ELO" are now internally updated before it is possible to pause the game, so that one can't leave play without last point being acknowledged.
* Online : Online rank scores "ELO" and their evolution are displayed for both players in pause menu.
* Online : Opponent nickname now becomes grey when they disconnect.
* Stats : Stats are now saved locally as well as using Steam, so that they can be restored if Steam messes them up.
* Bug fix : TOURNAMENT and CAREER saves during matches didn't properly store court side for respective players in order to resume play correctly.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash when using anim modding menu and going back to PRACTICE mode.
* Bug fix : Many fixes for year-end group competition : controller navigation was limited, next opponent display in group matches was wrong for 2nd and 3rd matches, game could freeze after forfeiting a group match.
* Bug fix : Fixed rare crash in online play, reported by user Rumba.

notes.title: Version 1.14.25
notes.notes:
* Modding : Added possibility to pick outfit for your character (in exhibition, practice, tournament (once at the beginning) and career (after each match) modes). Last outfit used per character in single games and practice is not stored as it would be too complicated.
* Gameplay settings : Modified aim target settings so that size is adjustable.
* Online : When your opponent's character is checked green, it also shows which list this character is part of on your side (makes it easier to differentiate between main players and modded players).
* Display settings : Texture quality is now adjustable for all textures instead of only court surface.
* Editor : Added option in stadium to enable/disable doubles alley.
* Editor : Improved longitude/latitude CSV import/export so that decimals aren't lost.
* Interface : Fixed some visual bugs when switching tournament or stadium in TOURNAMENT menu.
* Interface : Cosmetic tweaks and improvements.
* Visuals : Small fix for net 2 logo aspect.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash when exporting stadia to CSV in editor, introduced in v1.14.24.

notes.title: Version 1.14.24
notes.notes:
* Online : Several fixes and performance improvements with lobby handling and high number of connected players.
* Career : Added button in player sheet menu to export character to CSV.
* Visuals : Smoothened aim target movement with over-50Hz screen frequency.
* Bug fix : Fixed toss selection sometimes requiring too high values on analog pads.
* Interface : Fixes in german translation.

notes.title: Version 1.14.23
notes.notes:
* Bug fix : Fixed issues with properly playing serve_xxxx_before_xx.ogg sounds.
* Bug fix : Fixed crash in editor when importing CSV including either a tournament or stadium with a different UniqueID than those already in the database.
* Editor : Changed date format in CSV files to DD*MM*YYYY so that it doesn't depend on local computer settings.

notes.title: version 1.14.22
notes.notes: Bug fix : Fixed problems introduced in v1.14.21 when running the game without settings.fas present (for example running the game for the first time).

notes.title: Version 1.14.21
notes.notes:
* File management : Better prevention for saved file corruption : every time a saved file is correctly read by the game (and is therefore not corrupt), an copy is automatically created to potentially serve as a fallback.
* Visuals : Fixed visual glitch on timing orb with certain resolutions.
* Visuals : Changed material settings for crowd.

notes.title: Version 1.14.20
notes.notes:
* Gameplay : Nerfed defence by applying bigger speed and spin penalties on imperfect shots, while improving speed a bit on clean shots.
* Gameplay : Small tweak on lobs.
* AI : Fixed AI player sometimes remaining stuck in place instead of repositioning.
* AI : Fixed artificial limitation on AI first serve speed.
* AI : Improved AI decision-making when hitting smashes and volleys + improved AI predicting if the ball is going to go out before choosing to hit those shots.
* Visuals : Added adjustments for strokes according to ball height using bent knees and racket shift.
* Camera : Added possibility for low court-level camera using negative Height values.
* Career : Added option to choose starting year.
* Bug fix : A replay of the rally could wrongly be launched when umpire actually had called to replay the point.
* Interface : Added german translation.

notes.title: Version 1.14.19
notes.notes:
* Online : Abort msg box is now hidden when the game starts loading EXHIBITION menu.
* Online : Fixed bug where connection would silently be lost, forcing players to abort and try again.
* Online : Invite sound is not played anymore when the player is responding to you having specifically invited him. It will still play when someone responds to your auto(matic)-invite.

notes.title: Version 1.14.18
notes.notes:
* Bug fix : Invitation remained active when invited player became unavailable. It was then impossible to invite another player without leaving ONLINE menu and coming back.
* Crash fix : Removed crash when setting up an online game and opponent leaving, introduced in v1.14.17.

notes.title: Version 1.14.17
notes.notes: * Bug fix : Online menu could sometimes get in a state where attempting to connect with an opponent would never go through.

notes.title: Version 1.14.16
notes.notes:
* Settings : Added an option in CONTROLS menu allowing to tune dead zone % for analog inputs.
* Bug fix : When the same set score was used multiple times when umpire announces final score (for instance 6-4 6-4), only the last one was played.
* Bug fix : When certain devices like steering wheels were connected, menus could behave as though a direction was constantly pushed.
* Crash fix : Fixed crash in TOURNAMENT menu when using custom tournament and going back from the contestants screen.

notes.title: Version 1.14.15
notes.notes: * Online : Fixed crash happening randomly in lobby.

notes.title: Version 1.14.14
notes.notes: Online : Win-Loss count is displayed only for local player.

notes.title: Version 1.14.13
notes.notes:
* Online : Issues could happen when an online game was launched while online rank score had not yet been recovered through Steam. To avoid those issues, it is now impossible for a player to join an online game before his online rank score is displayed.
* Online : win-loss ratio for each player is now displayed after online rank score in lobby.

notes.title: Version 1.14.12
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Physics : Reworked ball-net collision physics, and adjusted bounce physics.
[*] Gameplay : Disabled 'clear net' auto-correction on dropshots and double tap slices, as it was wrongly enabled for those shots, which allowed easily reaching targets very close to the net.
[*] Controls : Fixed issue that prevented use of numeric pad for keyboard controls.
[*] Visuals : Fixed racket/hand shift on intermediate interpolations.
[*] Visuals : Stamina bar, serve bar and timing orb's movement smoothness on-screen now benefits from over-50 Hz monitor.
[*] Online : There is an issue where separate lobbies can be created simultaneously when several players launch the game at roughly the same time. They now should quickly merge when that happens (in a matter of seconds).
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.14.11
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Gameplay : Increased difficulty to make drop shots.
[*] Gameplay : Increased penalty for hitting the ball close to the ground.
[*] Gameplay : Code fix that should improve volley control.
[*] AI : Improved shot choice in response to drop shots.
[*] Sound : Fixed infamous bug that messed up stereo for in-game effects.
[*] Modding : Allowed _NCE prefix for modded bag textures.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14.0 : Gameplay, character movement, animations
notes.notes:
[h1]Don't forget you can go to the store page and nominate Full Ace for the 'Labor of love' award. There is still time ![/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P5a4J6ZSN1o

[list]
[*] Visuals : Many fixes/improvements on overall character movement, transition to and from shots.
[*] Rendering : Graphics engine's DirectX mode now uses DirectX 11. This should improve compatibility and performance on all computers, and opens up new graphical possibilities in the future.
[*] Physics : Refined ball-net collision physics.
[*] Gameplay : Tuned character speed, ability to change directions and overall rally rhythm.
[*] Gameplay : Changes and improvements for on-screen objects (timing orb & serve gauge)
[*] Gameplay : Tuned double tap power so it is easier to get intermediate values as well as fill it completely.
[*] Gameplay : Added colour-blind mode.
[*] Interface : Changed SETTINGS > CONTROLS menu and controller selection for more clarity.
[*] Replay : Added replay after a challenge if the point was a winner.
[*] Anim modding menu : Fix an issue in FBX Export that messed up "deplacement" and added sliding. Unfortunately the animations that were corrupted as a result of this can't be detected automatically and will have to be fixed by hand. Any FBX exported with an earlier version of the game shall be used with great care.
[*] Anim modding menu : Added log control displaying duplicated animations with same Unique ID.
[*] Anim modding menu : Allowed viewing modded animations and editing their flags when FBX source isn't available.
[*] Anim modding menu : Disabled editing one hand/both hands flags for serve animations and when FBX source isn't available.
[*] Editor display : Fixed animations display adding artificial sliding when shown in 3D view.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed some issues when hitting the shot button very early with automatic preparation enabled.
[*] Bug fix : Depth hint sometimes blinked when ball was bouncing near the net.
[*] Bug fix : Many many bug and crash fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.13.0 : Major modding changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Major modding changes : These changes open up a lot of new possibilities for modders. Installed modding data will be automatically converted, when launching Full Ace and accessing editor or any game mode. Documentation about modding is now available at [url=https://fullacetennis.blogspot.com/]https://fullacetennis.blogspot.com/[/url].
[*] Gameplay : Removed power penalty on dropshots and lobs.
[*] File safety : Every time you save in the editor, the previous version of data.fas will be backed-up as data.fas.bak.
[*] File safety : Every time you save a game, the previous version of saveXXXX.fas will be backed-up as saveXXXX.fas.bak.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed crash at the beginning of a challenge animation if the game was paused just before.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.12.0 : Gameplay & AI update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Gameplay : Modified gameplay for a better balance of penalties for hitting a shot in bad conditions (while running, preparing late, too low, too high, bad timing...).
[*] AI : Modified AI behavior according to gameplay changes and increased difficulty level for maximum settings.
[*] AI : Improved the way AI runs toward certain balls.
[*] Gameplay : Modified spin rates of several shots.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed crash in anim modding interface.
[*] Feature : Added support for new deciding set rules (10-point tiebreaks, tiebreak at 12-12).
[*] Editor : Added option for each stadium to have a double-width baseline (used on certain courts for TV).
[*] Interface : Added Discord link in main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.11.0 : Achievements added
notes.notes:
List of achievements : https://steamcommunity.com/stats/779430/achievements/

[list]
[*] Feature : Added achievements. Progress for online stats, TUTORIAL and CHALLENGE mode were already being tracked, so achievements linked to those will be immediately awarded when launching the new version. Others will have to be built from scratch.
[*] Gameplay : Challenge animation is now faster and focuses better on certain ball impacts. It is now possible to challenge balls that are further away from the lines than before.
[*] Gameplay : Small change in stamina system because characters with low stamina weren't able to reach their max speed when trying to recover a dropshot.
[*] Gameplay : Fixed unnatural spin on very short lobs.
[*] Gameplay : Prevented automatic replay when the point ending on the ball touching the net.
[*] Interface : The last player used in PRACTICE mode is now saved.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug where the human-controlled player's speed was artificially reduced when trying to recover a dropshot.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug where a new first serve was incorrectly granted after serving let, called in, but overruled out by challenge.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug where challenge POV would sometimes not show the proper picture in online games.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug in settings menu where certain manipulations would attribute illegal values to difficulty settings.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug that caused some glitchy transitions in character animations.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug where you couldn't watch the last replay in online game after connection was lost.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed crash when trying to load a FBX file with multi-layered animations for animation modding.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed crash in PRACTICE when opening pause menu, changing practice mode and exiting immediately.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New texture name convention to notify the game that a texture should be used as is, instead of using color edition, using suffix _NCE (for No Color Edit).
[*] New logo system that allows creating more logos and mixing them with any top or bottom clothes.
[*] New racket assets : racket is now textured for easier modding (an example is provided with 'raquette_10_NCE.png').
[*] For easier texture modding, right-clicking in the editor's 3d view now reloads textures.
[*] Changed EXHIBITION menu for online games so that chat isn't blocked after you choose BEGIN GAME, and can be cancelled as long as your opponent hasn't done the same.
[*] Fixed some tricky online synchronization issues, which should improve online experience when it comes to lag.
[*] Fixed online sync issues after one of the players opens SETTINGS menu.
[*] Fixed a difference of 0.4 millimeters on each side of the serve line between how it was displayed, and umpire/challenge calls, so that the ball would be called out when it should have been in.
[*] Fixed audio desync issues in replays saved during online games
[*] Fixed crash when using "save replay" button while viewing a previously saved replay.
[*] Fixed motion blur sometimes not displaying properly when exporting replay to video.
[*] Fixed some options being wrongly modifiable by client player in EXHIBITION menu when playing online.
[*] Fixed display of electronic challenges so that court lines are perfectly horizontal and vertical when showing IN/OUT.
[*] Fixed bug that caused crashes and file corruptions when some modded PNG images didn't have a full 256 color table.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9.1 : New clay assets and new online features.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/779430/ss_79c078666308b3653046e6133946034051ee9f0f.jpg?t=1559753982[/img]

[h1]Version 1.9.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rendering : Added small tweak so that some dust appears on clay court's lines.
[*] Camera : Fixed jerking camera during toss.
[*] Bug fix : Coin's heads-tails icon would sometimes not appear when opponent was choosing.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed regressions linked to online play that were introduced in version 1.9.0.
[/list]

[h1]Version 1.9.0[/h1]
[list]
[*] Graphics : New assets for rendering clay courts.
[*] Online : Added AUTO-INVITE option. When activated, anyone coming to the online lobby can respond to your invitation.
[*] Online : Lobby is now accessible from any point in the game, and displays the number of users currently playing the game offline/online. It also notifies you when a player activates AUTO-INVITE. Anonymous mode is activated by default so that your nickname doesn't appear when you're playing offline.
[*] Online : It is now possible to watch replay of the last point even after your opponent has disconnected.
[*] Rendering : Improved ball impact marks aspect.
[*] Performance : Fixed slowdown in main menu.
[*] Bug fix : Modded umpire name announcements had stopped working in exhibition mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.8.0 : Performance, memory usage & camera customization
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Performance and memory usage optimizations. Obvious effects are the following two :
[list]
[*] Memory usage : When using sound patches, you can expect a drastic drop in memory usage. In my tests, I dropped from around 700 Mb to around 100-150 Mb in the interface, and 200-250 Mb in-game.
[*] Performance : Small slowdowns used to happen in matches after some time. Those should not exist any more.
[/list]
[*] Settings : Added camera customization options and introduced new presets.
[*] Settings : Added "no split" setting to Local Multiplayer option (before, you had to uncheck Camera Behind Player to achieve the same result).
[*] Rendering : Fixed issues with specular lighting.
[*] Interface : Game now forces a restart when changing Anti Aliasing quality setting, as it should for the change to be effective.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.0 : AI improvements & character lists (PLEASE CHECK UPPERCASE WARNING)
notes.notes:
[*] AI : Several improvements, including making it more reactive, consistent and aggressive, and less prone to being wrong-footed.
[*] Database : Modified stats for characters in the database, in order to make career mode more realistic (the way stats are distributed along the rankings. Any resemblance with actual professional players is purely coincidental). Those changes will be automatically applied to the local data.fas, except when it would overwrite changes made by the user. YOU MAY WANT TO MAKE A BACKUP OF YOUR DATA.FAS BEFORE RUNNING THE NEW VERSION TO BE SAFE
[*] Career mode : Made several changes to make it more realistic when it comes to how AI players register in tournaments, and AI matches.
[*] Editor : Added options for user to manage character lists, including Cut-Copy-Paste icons (useful to have a separated list of characters for online play that won't interact with career mode, for instance).
[*] Gameplay : Reworked some aspects of the stamina system, so that it is more realistic and more consistent between AI opponents and human players, especially in career mode.
[*] Interface : Added possibility to select characters based on lists, and to filter based on country.
[*] Interface : Many small cosmetic changes and bug fixes.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed a bug that could make the game hang during a match or while simulating AI matches.
[*] Bug fix : Sometimes the human-controlled character would wait to hit the ball just after the 2nd bounce.
[*] Bug fix : Sometimes the human-controlled character would get stuck when the ball was coming at the right distance for his shot, preventing from adjusting forward or backward.
[*] Bug fix : The depth hint wouldn't update after the ball's trajectory would be modified by hitting the net.

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 : Ball highlight effect + fixes
notes.notes:
[*] Gameplay : Added an (optional and configurable) highlight effect to the ball to improve its visibility for people who might need it.
[*] Gameplay : Tuned volleys to make them more reliable.
[*] Bug fix : When tapping a button for serve while the ball was not in the player's hand, the serve bar would fill to max.
[*] Settings : Changed default setting to automatic preparation for pad controls.

notes.title: Version 1.5.1 : small improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[*] Gameplay : Added configuration options to challenge POV display : POV view may be disabled, and display can be positioned either top-right or bottom-right.
[*] Bug fix : Court lines weren't cleared between challenge POV renderings with DirectX.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed out-of-memory crash in player selection menu with DirectX.

notes.title: Version 1.5.0 : many improvements, bug fixes, and Russian translation
notes.notes:
[*] Gameplay : Modified speed values for many shots : they used to decrease on short distance shots to make sure the ball would clear the net. Now that it is handled automatically on safe shots, this is not needed anymore, and speed values aren't linked to distance any more.
[*] Gameplay : Added double tap slice. Second tap will make the shot and closer to the net, and a little faster.
[*] Gameplay : Added thumbnail view of ball bounce on challenges from player POV.
[*] Gameplay : Added possibility to cancel a shot by hitting any of the prepare buttons before ball impact.
[*] Animations : Improved some running animations.
[*] Online : Added sound effect when being invited to an online game.
[*] Sound modding : Allowed variations on many sounds, such as bounce_xx.ogg, app1_xx.ogg, app3_xx.ogg, net_xx.ogg, etc...
[*] Interface : Limited memory usage for player pictures in player selection menus.
[*] Interface : Added Russian translation.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed crash in editor when a modded anim is not available any more.
[*] Bug fix : Removed incorrect triggering of grunt sounds on volleys, dropshots and lobs.
[*] Bug fix : Removed incorrect display of aiming target in certain situations.

notes.title: Version 1.4.1 : gameplay improvement & general fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Gameplay : Modified "safe" shots (eg. one-tap topspin and backspin shots) so that they are slowed down to clear the net if they weren't going to. This is mostly to provide a viable play when playing the ball low and close to the net (typically when recovering a dropshot).
[*] Gameplay : Improved aiming for players (made it easier to keep a margin from the lines, compared to previous version).
[*] Modding : Fixed 2 systematic crashes in anim modding menu.
[*] Multiplayer : Fixes for local multiplayer display, added an option to disable stroke outcome area display.
[*] Sound : Fixed pre-serve sound so that it triggers correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 : Anim modding, Italian translation and more !
notes.notes:
Changes :

[list]
[*] Modding : Added possibility to create modded anims. Rudimentary instructions are available at http://www.fullacetennis.com/files/instructions.txt.
[*] Online : Added feedback on whether your opponent uses stadium and player that are consistent with their counterpart in your own database.
[*] Online : Added option to prevent from launching the game if your opponent uses a stadium and/or player that isn't consistent with their counterpart in your own database.
[*] Gameplay : Improved aiming for players (including making it easier to play cross-court when on the run).
[*] Gameplay : Improved running for short balls (including - but not limited to - drop shots). You still don't have many options to hit a drop shot back in play if you get it really low, but that'll be improved in a next update.
[*] Gameplay : Added an (optional) visual hint for ball height, allowing to better follow the ball and its trajectory. It can be used instead of the depth hint.
[*] Interface : Optimized creation of pictures when selecting players in certain cases where it used to lag a lot.
[*] Sound modding : Added new possibilities with the handling of new file patterns : stroke_lift_grunt_xx.ogg, stroke_lift_before_xx.ogg, serve_lift_grunt_xx.ogg, serve_lift_before_xx.ogg.
[*] Display : Added option to limit FPS to screen frequency (useful to reduce workload on some computers).
[*] Interface : Added italian translation.

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 : Chinese translation & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Changes

[*] Gameplay : Tweaked double tap flat shots to nerf their precision.
[*] Interface : Added chinese translation.
[*] Bug fix : Fixed bug preventing from importing stadium and tournament data from CSV files.
[*] Bug fix : Added system to detect corruption of settings.fas file, so that a new file is created instead of the game refusing to launch.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 : Framerate unlock & Spanish translation !
notes.notes:
Changes :
[*] Engine : Unlocked rendering frame rate.
[*] Render : Some tweaks for lighting.
[*] Display : Added scoreboard messages for deuce count, break points, set points, match points, and championship points.
[*] Display : Improved quality for scoreboard and serve speed counter displays.
[*] Gameplay : Decreased error on strong shots.
[*] Gameplay : Small fix to prevent some aborted shots.
[*] Interface : Added spanish translation.

notes.title: Version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Changes :
* Gameplay : Changed serve system so that slower (typically 2nd) serves are less difficult to perform.
* Gameplay : Fixed making small positioning adjustments with keyboard.

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Changes :
* Gameplay : Changed some spin parameters for serves : slices are more realistic, and topspin serves are more like kick serves, allowing "twisting" on slower speeds.
* Gameplay : Improved running with keyboard.
* Bug fix : Average stat in editor was wrong by an additional 2 points. Now displaying 2 decimal places.
* Bug fix : Circumvented Steam system to properly display online rankings.
* Bug fix : Sometimes hitting a button to end cinematic right at the end of set would also skip the stats screen.
* Bug fix : Copying a player in editor didn't allow the new one a different Unique ID. IDs that were duplicated that way will also be automatically fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Changes :
* Gameplay : Added setting for adjusting serve difficulty.
* Gameplay : Changed serve system so that errors in timing have more impact, especially when using high power.
* Gameplay : Adjustment to v1.1.1's strokes system to be easier with low values of timing shot sensitivity.
* Sound : Added independent volume setting for umpire announcements.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Changes :

* Steam : Cloud saves enabled.
* Gameplay : Error margins on shots have been reworked for better balance.
* Gameplay : Parameters for topspin, attacks and dropshots have been tweaked for more realism.
* Gameplay : Preparing early now gives you a boost in shot precision, preparing late gives you a penalty. There is a small penalty on this when using auto-prepare, as an incentive and reward to play manual.
* AI : Improvements in tactics and overall quality of play.
* Online : Added system to detect score desyncs. When it happens, the point will be replayed, and replay files for both players are saved locally. Those replays can be sent to us to help us understand the cause of the desync and fix it.
* Sound : Used pitch to make shoe squeak sounds less repetitive and annoying.
* Sound : Interface sounds are now paused when game window is minimized.
* Bug fix : In online games, chat would become unavailable after selecting a player.
* Bug fix : When a serve would touch the net and land in, and the returner played it, the point would be handled as though there was no let.
* Bug fix : When a 2nd serve call out was successfully challenged, the server would have to hit a 2nd serve instead of a 1st serve according to official rules.
* Bug fix : When a 2nd serve touched the net, was called out, and was successfully challenged, the server would be awarded the point. Now the point is replayed, as should be.
* Bug fix : In certain cases, human players would hit the ball higher than they were supposed to on serves.
* Bug fix : Keyboard strokes were being detected by the game even when the window wasn't in foreground.
* Bug fix : Timing orb would display wrong colors when shot button was pressed very early.
* Bug fix : In career mode, human player wasn't always automatically registered in 2-week events when eligible.
* Bug fix : In career mode, after displaying the list of players for a tournament that haven't started yet, it was impossible to close it with the pad.
* Bug fix : Stamina bars used to appear in replays.
